clue.text: Out-and-out!

parts.note: read as 'out, and out again': a batsman dismissed when the bowler both bowls the ball and catches it, so the bowler gets him out twice over

explanation.walkthrough: 'Out-and-out' looks like the everyday word for 'complete', but it describes a cricket dismissal in which the bowler is credited with the wicket twice, as bowler and as catcher.
explanation.definitionFit: A cricket dismissal where the bowler takes the catch off their own delivery, so the batsman is out in a doubly emphatic way.

clue.text: Craftsman's on form in the workshop

parts.note: a carpenter is a craftsman in wood; the possessive is kept
a form is a long backless seat, a bench

explanation.surface: A joiner shows off his skills inside his workshop.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Form' reads as 'good form' but is the old word for a schoolroom bench; the definition is loose, naming where the thing is found.
explanation.definitionFit: A woodworker's sturdy table is the main fixture found inside a joinery shop.

clue.text: Superior sort of cut

definitions.meaning: a boxer's rising punch to the chin is named with this word before 'cut'

explanation.definitionFit: Means higher in position, and also begins the name of a boxing punch thrown upward at the chin.

clue.text: Worker has no right to boast of a small suitcase

parts.note: a hand is a manual worker, as in farmhand

indicators.note: says the letter for right, R, is removed from the word for boasting

parts.note: to brag is to boast

explanation.surface: A labourer has no business showing off about his little case.
explanation.walkthrough: 'no right' strips R from BRAG to leave BAG.
explanation.definitionFit: A bag carried in the hand is a small piece of luggage, a little case.

clue.text: A child under care, 'e'd been given a prize

parts.note: a ward is a child placed under a guardian's care
the dropped-aitch spelling of he'd, giving the letters ED

explanation.surface: A youngster in foster care says he's won a prize.
explanation.walkthrough: ''e'd' is Cockney he'd with the H dropped, simply supplying ED.
explanation.definitionFit: To win a prize is to have it conferred on you by judges.

clue.text: US city tried to reorganize

indicators.note: reorganizing means the letters of these words are put into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: An American city made an attempt to restructure itself.
explanation.definitionFit: The Michigan city known as the home of the American car industry.

clue.text: Old boy's part of the act is indecent

parts.note: Old boy's gives OB
a scene is a division of an act in a play

explanation.surface: A former pupil's contribution to the stage show is improper.
explanation.definitionFit: Offensive to accepted standards of modesty, lewd.

clue.text: Small horse-drawn carriage allowed to become a type of motor-car

parts.note: a landau is a four-wheeled horse-drawn carriage with a folding top
to let is to allow

explanation.surface: A little horse carriage is permitted to turn into an automobile.
explanation.walkthrough: Strictly a landau is not small; the name of the car body is itself a diminutive of the carriage, which the clue's 'Small' nods to.
explanation.definitionFit: An early car body with a folding hood over the rear seats, named after the carriage it copied.

clue.text: Gets out the hair-clippers and comb and flares up!

definitions.text: Gets out the hair-clippers and comb and flares up!

parts.words: Gets out the hair-clippers and comb and flares up!
parts.note: the barber's tools suggest removing locks of hair, a de-tressing, while flares sent up are emergency calls for help at sea

explanation.walkthrough: The clue plays on 'tress', a lock of hair: cutting tresses is a pun on the first word, and flares fired upward are calls for rescue.
explanation.definitionFit: Flares, rockets and the like used to call for help in an emergency.

clue.text: Again confined worker in a sorry state

parts.note: re- is a prefix meaning again
pent, as in pent-up, means shut in
an ant is the classic worker insect

explanation.surface: A labourer is locked up once more and in a bad way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in a sorry state' reads as wretched but means feeling sorry, contrite.
explanation.definitionFit: Feeling regret for one's wrongdoing, contrite.

clue.text: Found on the beach and in the ship

indicators.note: says the word and sits inside the ship's letters

parts.note: SS, steamship, is the standard ship abbreviation

explanation.surface: Something seen on the shore and also aboard the vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: The fine grains making up a beach or seashore.

clue.text: Invested in a gown in conclusion

indicators.note: the second in tells us the gown sits inside the word for conclusion

parts.note: an end is a conclusion
a robe is a gown

explanation.surface: Someone was finally dressed up in ceremonial robes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Invested' suggests money, but here it means formally clothed, as at an investiture.
explanation.definitionFit: To invest someone is to clothe them in the robes of office.

clue.text: Perform in opera at places out of doors

indicators.note: the letters of these two words are made to act out a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Sing in an opera staged outside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Perform' seems to be a verb for singing, but it shuffles IN and OPERA; 'at' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The outdoors, space unenclosed by walls or roof.

clue.text: Priest or essayist for the most part

indicators.note: says only most of the essayist's name is used, with its last letter dropped

parts.note: Elia was the pen name of the essayist Charles Lamb

explanation.surface: A clergyman or a writer of essays, mostly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for the most part' trims the final A from ELIA. Eli was the priest who raised Samuel.
explanation.definitionFit: The Old Testament priest at Shiloh who brought up the boy Samuel.

clue.text: Some understood it was like a tree

definitions.meaning: informal British 'twig' means grasp or catch on
having small branches, as a tree does

explanation.walkthrough: 'twig' as a verb is informal British for realising something.
explanation.definitionFit: Caught on, in slang; and also bearing small branches.

clue.text: Hanging over one member before the finish

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
MP is a Member of Parliament
an ending is a finish

explanation.surface: A politician waits anxiously before the end.
explanation.definitionFit: About to happen, threatening, like a looming storm.

clue.text: Girl appearing the day before

definitions.meaning: the evening or day preceding a festival, as in Christmas ___

explanation.definitionFit: A woman's name, and also the day preceding an event.

clue.text: I'll rest drunkenly on the lattice-work

indicators.note: acting drunkenly, these letters stagger into a new order

explanation.surface: A tipsy man says he'll lie down against the garden lattice.
explanation.definitionFit: A framework of crossed strips for climbing plants.

clue.text: He is found deep in prayer

indicators.note: says the letters sit within the word prayer

explanation.surface: A man is discovered deep in prayer.
explanation.definitionFit: A man's name, so a 'he'.

clue.text: Sit in the shade having rested

indicators.note: places the word for sitting inside the colour

parts.note: red is a shade, a colour
to pose is to sit for an artist

explanation.surface: Sit in the shadow after taking a rest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shade' suggests shadow, but it is a colour.
explanation.definitionFit: Lay at ease, having rested.

clue.text: Lads can upset with malicious gossip

indicators.note: upsetting the letters of these words knocks them into a new order

explanation.surface: Boys can cause trouble with spiteful tittle-tattle.
explanation.definitionFit: Outrage-causing talk or rumour damaging to reputation.

clue.text: Physician moved slowly and cleaned out a channel

parts.note: DR is short for doctor
edged means inched along

explanation.surface: A doctor crept along and cleared a waterway.
explanation.definitionFit: Scooped mud and silt from the bed of a river or harbour.

clue.text: Moves in revolutionary circles

parts.note: suggests radical political company, but really means spinning round and round

explanation.walkthrough: 'revolutionary circles' sounds like radical politics; it means turning in circles.
explanation.definitionFit: Spins or whirls round a central point.

clue.text: First lieutenant in strong wind on the ship

indicators.note: puts that letter inside the word for strong wind

parts.note: a gale is a strong wind

indicators.note: takes only the opening letter of lieutenant

explanation.surface: The first officer is out in a gale on board the vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: A large sailing warship of the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries, as in the Spanish Armada.

clue.text: Hold back the twelfth man

definitions.meaning: in cricket the twelfth man is the substitute player

explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the twelfth man is the team's substitute, fielding if someone is injured.
explanation.definitionFit: To keep something back; also a substitute player held in readiness.

clue.text: Drowned valley is dry on the way back

indicators.note: says the word for dry is read in reverse

parts.note: to air washing is to dry it

explanation.surface: A flooded valley is parched when you return.
explanation.walkthrough: A ria is a long sea inlet formed by a river valley flooded by rising sea level.
explanation.definitionFit: A coastal inlet formed where the sea has flooded a river valley.

clue.text: Players to get on with dressing

parts.note: a band is a group of musicians, players
to age is to get on in years

explanation.surface: Musicians carry on while getting changed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dressing' reads as putting clothes on but means a wound covering.
explanation.definitionFit: A strip of material wrapped round a wound.

clue.text: After all in Greek capital it is permanent

parts.note: last comes after all the others

indicators.note: takes the capital, the opening letter, of Greek

explanation.surface: In Athens, after all, things are meant to endure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Greek capital' suggests Athens but means the letter G.
explanation.definitionFit: Enduring, going on for a long time.

clue.text: House blocked by snow

parts.note: sounds like a home cut off by drifts, but describes a dwelling built from blocks of snow

explanation.walkthrough: 'blocked by snow' suggests snowed in; it means made of snow blocks.
explanation.definitionFit: The Inuit dome-shaped shelter made of snow blocks.

clue.text: Nymph appears in a new advertisement

annotationWithheld.why: Clue as held 'Nymph appears in a new advertisement' gives N, A and AD but no source for the I of NAIAD; likely an OCR loss (e.g. 'one'), no scan or online copy found.
annotationWithheld.clue: Nymph appears in a new advertisement

clue.text: One heard of an ape engaged in warfare

indicators.note: says the word for the ape is taken as spoken, giving a word of the same sound

parts.note: a gorilla is the largest ape

explanation.surface: Someone has heard tell of an ape fighting in a war.
explanation.walkthrough: 'engaged in warfare' completes the sense of 'One': an irregular fighter. The ape and fighter are pronounced alike.
explanation.definitionFit: An irregular fighter in a small independent band, someone engaged in warfare.

clue.text: Like a steeplejack's job, very risky

definitions.meaning: a steeplejack works up tall spires, so the risk is at height

explanation.definitionFit: Extremely perilous, and punningly descriptive of work done at height on chimneys and spires.
